issues.message: 'No swap because every position closes on the entry day': the broker rollover is 17:00 New York = 22:00 London. Entries at 16:03 held 360 minutes exit at 22:03 and pay one night's swap (triple on Wednesdays); 60 and 180 minutes pay none. V2 keeps its real swap (more conservative). Reply CONFIRMED or CORRECTED.
'Force close by 23:55 Europe/London': if the 23:55 M1 bar is missing, V2 closes on the next available bar. With holding <= 360 minutes from 16:03 this never applies.
